answer_2.quote: a statistical analysis of vector representations able to capture gender and occupational biases in free-form texts

answer_4.quote: We ask two annotators to label generated texts according to 4 dimensions: gender assignment, subject misinterpretation, the topic discussed in the text and, finally, whether the lexical focus of the text expresses agency or communion.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators were given access to pairs of prompts and relative generated sequence. Gender: assess the models' ability to recognize and respect the gender expressed by the prompt. Subject: assess whether the subject is correctly interpreted as a human identity. Topic: express which topics are addressed in the generated sequence. Agency vs Communion: assess whether the lexicon emphasizes competence and assertiveness (agency) or warmth, morality, and 'getting along' (communion).
